narrative:
## Handover Summary — Cost to Serve

Cost drivers validated for the delivery workforce, subcontractors, telephony, technology, sites and KPI credits.

## Key Decisions
• 120 CSPS surge FTE released from Q4 as productivity reaches 1.4 cases per hour (−GBP 9M)
• Citizen contact overheads re-allocated by handled minutes, not headcount
• Regulated Services stranded cost exited in step with handbacks (−GBP 7M)

## Recommendation for Workforce Phase
Redeploy FTE released by virtual agents to casework backlogs before any exit decisions.

signals.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
signals.source: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
signals.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.
